title: ESM-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Whether AI Agents Understand Earth System Model Physics and Code
abstract: arXiv:2611.28477v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI coding agents that modify Earth System Model (ESM) code must preserve both software interfaces and the physical assumptions encoded in them. We introduce ESM-Bench, a benchmark of 60 developer-commit tasks from 6 repositories: Noah-MP, CLM5, SUMMA, ParFlow, MOM6, and VIC. The v5 corpus contains 17 physics-based bug fixes, 16 process-representation modifications, 13 parameterization-scheme selections, and 14 parameter-optimization tasks. Each task includes a scientific objective, parent-commit source files, a reference diff, and three stored prompt variants. An artifact audit confirms that all 60 reference diffs apply to their supplied starting files. We define an eight-item patch-review rubric and audit five archived patch fixtures against the implemented local checkers. None of the five fixture diffs applies to its supplied starting files, yet three text-pattern checkers return a pass. A ParFlow expression replay disagrees with the r

translated_title: ESM-Bench：一个用于评估AI智能体是否理解地球系统模型物理与代码的基准测试
translated_abstract: 修改地球系统模型（ESM）代码的AI编程智能体必须同时保持软件接口及其编码的物理假设不变。我们提出了ESM-Bench，这是一个包含来自6个代码库（Noah-MP、CLM5、SUMMA、ParFlow、MOM6和VIC）的60个开发者提交任务的基准测试。v5语料库包含17个基于物理的缺陷修复、16个过程表示修改、13个参数化方案选择任务和14个参数优化任务。每个任务包含一个科学目标、父提交源文件、一个参考差异以及三种存储的提示词变体。工件审计确认所有60个参考差异均可应用于其提供的起始文件。我们定义了一个包含八项内容的补丁审查评分标准，并根据已实现的本地检查器审计了五个存档的补丁样例。五个样例差异中没有一个能应用于其提供的起始文件，但仍有三个文本模式检查器返回通过。一个ParFlow表达式重放与参考结果不一致（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: ESM-Bench是一个基于6个地球系统模型代码库中60个真实开发者提交任务构建的基准测试，用于评估AI智能体在修改模型代码时能否同时保持物理假设与软件接口的正确性，并通过补丁审查标准揭示了现有本地检查器可能产生误报的缺陷。
en_tdlr: ESM-Bench is a benchmark of 60 real developer-commit tasks from six Earth System Model repositories that evaluates whether AI agents can modify model code while preserving physical assumptions and software interfaces, and reveals through patch-review auditing that existing local checkers can produce false passes.
